terms.visitorBody: A daily unique identifier derived server-side from the site, a rotating salt, and the visitor's truncated IP and browser. It resets every 24 hours, so totals across more than one day are a sum of daily uniques, not a true distinct count over the whole range.
terms.sessionBody: A run of activity from one visitor. It ends after 30 minutes with no tracked event, and a new campaign context (e.g. arriving from a new ad click) always starts a new session.
terms.engagedSessionBody: A session is engaged if it has at least 10 seconds of active time or at least 2 page views. Engaged rate is the share of sessions meeting that bar.
terms.bounceRateBody: 1 minus engaged rate. Always shown alongside engaged rate, never on its own — a bounce rate with no visible engagement threshold is easy to misread.
terms.comparisonPeriodBody: The immediately preceding period of equal length — a 7-day range compares against the 7 days right before it, so the delta is always like-for-like in duration.
terms.privacyFloorBody: A breakdown row covering fewer than 5 distinct visitors is flagged rather than hidden — the underlying number is real, but small enough that showing it standalone could identify an individual visit.
